resources.string:
Version %2$s, %1$s
Start again to update to version %3$s
Start by connecting to a computer
For devices without root, you need to use adb to start Rootzuku (requires computer connection). This process needs to be repeated every time the device is restarted. Please read the help.

%1$s

* There are some other considerations, please confirm that you have read the help first.

On Android 11 or above, you can enable Wireless debugging and start Rootzuku directly from your device, without connecting to a computer.

Please view the step-by-step guide first.
Before Android 11, connecting to a computer is required to enable Wireless debugging.

Please enable \"Wireless debugging\" in \"Developer options\". \"Wireless debugging\" is automatically disabled when network changes.\n\nNote, do not disable \"Developer options\" or \"USB debugging\", or Rootzuku will be stopped.
Please try to disable and enable \"Wireless debugging\" if it keeps searching.
Port is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.
Can\'t connect to wireless debugging service.
Wireless debugging is not enabled.\nNote, before Android 11, to enable wireless debugging, computer connection is a must.

Please start paring by the following steps: \"Developer Options\" - \"Wireless debugging\" - \"Pairing device using pairing code\".\n\nAfter the pairing process starts, you will able to input the pairing code.
The system requires the pairing dialog always visible, using split-screen mode is the only way to let this app and system dialog visible at the same time.
Unable to generate key for wireless debugging.\nThis may be because KeyStore mechanism of this device is broken.
Please go through the pairing step first.
A notification from Rootzuku will help you complete the pairing.
Enter \"Developer options\" - \"Wireless debugging\". Tap \"Pair device with pairing code\", you will see a six-digit code.
Enter the code in the notification to complete pairing.
The pairing process needs you to interact with a notification from Rootzuku. Please allow Rootzuku to post notifications.
MIUI users may need to switch notification style to \"Android\" from \"Notification\" - \"Notification shade\" in system settings.
Otherwise, you may not able to enter paring code from the notification.
Please note, left part of the \"Wireless debugging\" option is clickable, tapping it will open a new page. Only turing on the switch on the right is incorrect.
Back to Rootzuku and start Rootzuku.
Rootzuku needs to access local network. It is controlled by the network permission.

Some systems (such as MIUI) disallow apps to access the network when they are not visible, even if the app uses foreground service as standard. Please disable battery optimization features for Rootzuku on such systems.

In addition, Rootzuku can be started automatically on boot. If not, please check if your system or third-party tools have restricted Rootzuku.
You can refer to %s.
If you are using Magisk, you can try %1$s. For root users, it will eventually replace Rootzuku. Note, existing applications needs to change a little to use %2$s.
Apps that has requested or declared Rootzuku will show here.
Learn how to develop with Rootzuku
You need to take an extra step

Your device manufacturer has restricted adb permissions and apps using Rootzuku will not work properly.

Usually, this limitation can be lifted by adjusting some options in "Developer options". Please read the help for details on how to do this.

You may need to restart Rootzuku for the operation to take effect.
The permission of adb is limited

It\'s highly possible that your device manufacturer limits the permission of adb.

There may be a solution for your system in this document.
Run commands through Rootzuku in terminal apps you like
First, Export files to any where you want. You will find two files, %1$s and %2$s.

If there are files with the same name in the selected folder, they will be deleted.\n\nThe export function uses SAF (Storage Access Framework). It\'s reported that MIUI breaks the functions of SAF. If you are using MIUI, you may have to extract the file from Rootzuku\'s apk or download from GitHub.
Then, use any text editor to open and edit %1$s.
For example, if you want to use Rootzuku in %1$s, you should replace %2$s with %3$s (%4$s is the package name of %1$s).
Finally, move the files to somewhere where your terminal app can access, you will be able to use %1$s to run commands through Rootzuku.
Some tips: grant execute permission to %1$s and add it to %2$s, you will able to use %1$s directly.

With %1$s, in any terminal app, you can connect to and interact with the shell runs by Rootzuku.

About the detailed usage %1$s, tap to view the document.
Use the pure black theme if night mode is enabled
Help us translate %s into your language
For rooted devices, Rootzuku is able to start automatically on boot
You can start Rootzuku service now.
Allow the app to use Rootzuku.
Can\'t start service because root permission is not granted or this device is not rooted.

Legacy Rootzuku has been deprecated since March 2019. Also, legacy Rootzuku does not work on newer Android systems.

Please ask the developer of %1$s to update.

%1$s has modern Rootzuku support, but it\'s requesting legacy Rootzuku. This could because Rootzuku is not running, please check in Rootzuku app.

Legacy Rootzuku has been deprecated since March 2019.
Could not start Rootzuku automatically. Open the app to start it.
Keep a notification that shows whether Rootzuku is running, with start and stop buttons
Start Rootzuku again when it stops unexpectedly, for example after the network changed. Needs the status notification.
Stop the service. Apps will not be able to use Rootzuku until it is started again.
Run commands with Rootzuku permissions inside this app
See which apps used Rootzuku and what they did
Shell started as %1$s. Interactive programs that need a real terminal are not supported.
Long-press an app to limit what it can do
This needs the new version of the service. Start Rootzuku again to update it.
Nothing yet. Activity is recorded only while the service is running and is erased when it stops.

This app was turned off in a way that adb permission cannot undo directly.\n\nRootzuku can reinstall the app over itself from its own files, which turns it on again. The app data is kept. The app will then count as installed by adb instead of its store.
This app has no screen to open, or it is frozen
Open this folder in the other pane
The inside of an archive cannot be changed
Cannot open this file as an archive
Both panes show the same folder
Size of one part in MB. The parts are named .001, .002 and so on. For a FAT32 drive use 4095 or less.
Faster animations, performance mode and a clean background with one switch
Closes the apps that wait in the background
Asks the system to run a game in performance mode. Only games that support it change.
Faster processing for everything except games. Uses more battery.
Remove %d apps? They can be brought back with \"Restore removed apps\".
None of the known optional apps is installed
Large file, only the beginning is shown
This phone cannot play this file. Use \"Open with\" to choose another app.
Files in this folder cannot be shared together. Copy them to another folder first.
Deleted files are kept for 30 days in a hidden folder before they are removed for good
Start a private on-device VPN that filters ad and tracker domains for every app and the browser
On. Filtering ad domains for all apps.
Blocks ads in some apps and websites. Only one VPN runs at a time.
Point Private DNS at AdGuard so ad domains are refused across apps and the browser
On. Blocks most ad domains everywhere.
Turn off ads inside an app
Disable the ad libraries (AdMob, AppLovin, Unity Ads…) inside a chosen app
Measures how quickly each server answers from your network
Answer time of the internet right now
Nothing answered. Either there is no internet, or this network blocks ping.
Stops apps from using the internet in the background, which leaves the line to the app you are using
Block or allow the internet for one app while it is in the background
Turns airplane mode on for 3 seconds so the phone connects again
Put DNS and the network tweaks back to default and restart the connections
This turns off Private DNS and the network tweaks, re-enables Wi-Fi and data, and restarts the radios. Saved Wi-Fi passwords are kept.
Recycle bin: keep deleted files for 30 days
Force a high refresh rate, such as 120 or 165 Hz
Floating meter for frame rate, processor, memory and graphics
A small overlay over games and other apps
Rootzuku needs permission to draw over other apps. Turn it on for Rootzuku on the next screen, then enable the meter again.
Give each game its own performance settings
Watch the foreground app and apply each game\'s profile while it is open, then put everything back
Render the game at a smaller resolution for a higher frame rate. It is put back to full when you leave the game. If the screen looks wrong, turn it off.
Ask the system for full performance, uses more battery
Close background apps when the game starts
Let the GPU compose the screen. Can smooth some games, can hurt others.
Switch the screen to vivid mode for more saturated colours while playing
Make the screen react to a lighter touch
Silence notifications and calls while playing
Keep the network for the game
Stop other apps from using data in the background while playing
Show the floating FPS and load meter in this game
Open the game. The profile applies by itself.
Turn on \"Apply automatically\" first, so the profile is applied.
Turn on the dark theme for apps that have one
Darken apps that have no dark theme of their own
Done. Reopen apps to see the change.
Lock the whole screen to portrait
Lock the whole screen to landscape
Keep the screen on whenever the device is plugged in
Draw a dot where you touch the screen, useful for recording
Show the pointer position and movement data across the top
Keep the mobile radio ready so it switches from Wi-Fi faster
Let apps scan for Wi-Fi more often
Hide the status and navigation bars across the whole system
Set window, transition and animator scales to zero for a faster feel
Turn the device location on or off
Turn all sensors off (accelerometer, gyroscope, light…). Turn back on to restore them.
Open the classic ADB port, then start over USB with no Wi-Fi until the next reboot.
Connect to the classic port on 127.0.0.1 and start the service. Open the port first.
Opens the classic ADB port over wireless debugging this once, so later USB starts work with no Wi-Fi until the next reboot. Turn on wireless debugging first.
The classic ADB port is open. You can start over USB now with Wi-Fi off (until the next reboot).
Opening the port over wireless debugging...
No wireless debugging port found. Turn on wireless debugging (Developer options) and connect to Wi-Fi once, then try again.
Could not open the classic port. Make sure wireless debugging is on and the device is paired.
No screens found in this app
Freeze, stop, clear or remove apps, system apps too
Delete all data of %1$s? This cannot be undone.
%1$s is a system app. It will be removed for your user only. Removing the wrong system app can break the phone. Continue?
This app has no permissions to manage
Run your commands with one tap or after every boot
No saved commands. Add one from the menu.

Logcat and the Rootzuku activity log
My accounts and how to support the project

Pull this notification down and type the code here
Go to the target folder and choose Paste from the menu
Open apps that refuse developer options or USB debugging

Open a protected app from here or from its home screen shortcut. Developer options and USB debugging are turned off first, so Rootzuku stops. After you leave the app they are turned on again and Rootzuku is restarted, which needs Wi-Fi.
Tap to open hidden · long-press for a shortcut

Off. That is fine while Rootzuku is running.
Missing. Start on boot, stealth mode and auto restart need it. It is given when Rootzuku starts.

Not allowed. The pairing code and the status notification need them.
The system may stop this app in the background. Set it to unrestricted.
If it is on, it blocks USB debugging commands and Rootzuku cannot start. Check it under Security and privacy.
Block ads on the whole phone with one tap
Private DNS sends the name lookups of all apps to the server you choose. Servers that block ads answer with nothing for advertising addresses.
